work.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
work.summary: Drive ADAS validation, simulation-based verification, and closed-loop performance engineering for next-generation vehicle intelligence systems.
highlights: Developed and validated closed-loop ADAS logic for Lane Keeping Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control using MATLAB/Simulink and Stateflow.
Built scenario-based simulation frameworks in SCANeR Studio to assess perception, control, and vehicle-level behavior under realistic operating conditions.
Applied Kalman Filter, EKF, and Particle Filter methods for radar-camera sensor fusion and state estimation to improve signal quality and decision confidence.
Automated ISO 18571 signal correlation, KPI extraction, and reporting pipelines with Python to accelerate validation and reduce manual effort.

work.name: IIT Madras
work.summary: Modeled nonlinear electromechanical systems and conducted advanced system dynamics research in energy harvesting and intelligent control applications.
highlights: Analyzed nonlinear MEMS energy harvesting systems using phase-plane and time-series methods to understand dynamic instability and energy conversion behavior.
Studied electromechanical coupling and optimization-driven parameter effects in nonlinear systems to improve modeling fidelity and design insight.
